SQL_Text: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_Ward_Consolidated_status_Report_Update] AS BEGIN    SET NOCOUNT ON;    /* ============================================================    CLEANUP TEMP TABLES    ============================================================ */    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BASE;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PAYMENT_DATA;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE125;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE130_CURR;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE130_HIST;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #STATUS_AGG;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AGGREGATED;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FINAL_DATA;    /* ============================================================    BASE DATA    ============================================================ */    SELECT DISTINCT a.App_Id,       a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationId,       a.GBA,       a.GBAId,       b.MD_ZoneId,       LTRIM(RTRIM( REPLACE( REPLACE(ISNULL(b.MD_Zonename, ''), CHAR(160), ' '), CHAR(9), ' ' ) )) AS MD_Zonename,       b.MD_WardId,       LTRIM(RTRIM( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( ISNULL(b.MD_WardName, ''), CHAR(160), ' ' -- Non-breaking space -> normal space       ), CHAR(9), ' '                                                                                     -- Tab -> space       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 1       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 2       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 3       ) )) AS MD_WardName,       a.App_Status,       a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       a.App_Source,       a.App_MotherEPID,       a.isFinalPaymentDone,       a.finalPaymentDate,       CASE          WHEN             a.App_Source = 'newkhata'          THEN 'NEWKHATA'          ELSE 'OTHER'       END AS SourceType    INTO #BASE    FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a WITH (NOLOCK)    INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.App_Id = b.MD_APP_ID    WHERE a.App_Active                   = 1    AND ISNULL(a.isProcessingFeePaid, 0) = 1    AND a.App_Status                     >= 10    AND ISNULL(a.IsPushedToGps, 0)       = 1;    /* Clustered index for the payment join (App_Id is unique per #BASE row) */ CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_AppId ON #BASE (App_Id); /* Covering non-clustered index for all the GROUP BY work below. This replaces the old #BASE_UNIQUE table+clustered-index copy. */ CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_Grouping ON #BASE    (       GBAId,       MD_ZoneId,       MD_WardId,       SourceType    ) INCLUDE    (       App_Id,       GBA,       MD_Zonename,       MD_WardName,       App_Status,       App_Source,       App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       isFinalPaymentDone,       finalPaymentDate    ) ; /* ============================================================ PAYMENT DATA ============================================================ */ SELECT f.FPC_AppId AS App_Id,    SUM(ISNULL(f.FPC_AmountCalculated, 0)) AS Payment_Amount INTO #PAYMENT_DATA FROM dbo.BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn f WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE f.FPC_Active      = 1 AND f.FPC_Pay_Isdisplay = 1 GROUP BY f.FPC_AppId; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_PAYMENT_DATA_AppId ON #PAYMENT_DATA (App_Id); /* ============================================================ MAIN AGGREGATION (counts, payments) - grain: GBA/Zone/Ward/SourceType ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    COUNT(*) AS Total_Citizens,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sketch_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CaseWorker_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1000, 1110) AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CaseWorker_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (14, 1000, 1110) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (150, 1500, 1100, 1111, 200, 300) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 0 AND a.App_Status = 300 AND a.finalPaymentDate <= DATEADD(DAY, -3, GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PaymentPendingEaasthi,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BtoAConvertedCount,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SPACount,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1500, 1100) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commissioner_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Status = 300 AND p.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_Count,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Status = 300 THEN ISNULL(p.Payment_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_Amount INTO #AGGREGATED FROM #BASE a LEFT JOIN #PAYMENT_DATA p ON a.App_Id = p.App_Id GROUP BY a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType; --CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_AGGREGATED_Grouping ON #AGGREGATED (GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_WardId, SourceType); /* ============================================================ ROLE-BASED FLAGS - built ONCE from the transaction tables, instead of a correlated EXISTS re-run per metric. ============================================================ */ SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE125 FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE125 ON #ROLE125 (App_Id); SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE130_CURR FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE130_CURR ON #ROLE130_CURR (App_Id); SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE130_HIST FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran_hist WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130 AND Sts_MainAppStatus IN (200,                           300); CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE130_HIST ON #ROLE130_HIST (App_Id); /* ============================================================ STATUS-DERIVED METRICS - single pass replaces #JC_REJECTED + #COMM_COMPLETED + #COMM_REJECTED ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status = 110 AND r125.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_REJECTED,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (200, 300) AND ( r130h.App_Id IS NOT NULL OR r130c.App_Id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commissioner_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status = 1111 AND r130c.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMM_REJECTED INTO #STATUS_AGG FROM #BASE a LEFT JOIN #ROLE125 r125 ON a.App_Id = r125.App_Id LEFT JOIN #ROLE130_CURR r130c ON a.App_Id = r130c.App_Id LEFT JOIN #ROLE130_HIST r130h ON a.App_Id = r130h.App_Id WHERE a.App_Status IN (110,                        200,                        300,                        1111) GROUP BY a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_STATUS_AGG_Grouping ON #STATUS_AGG (GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_WardId, SourceType); /* ============================================================ FINAL DATA  ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    a.Total_Citizens,    a.Sketch_Pending,    a.CaseWorker_Pending,    a.CaseWorker_Completed,    a.JC_Pending,    a.JC_Completed,    ISNULL(s.JC_REJECTED, 0) AS JC_REJECTED,    ISNULL(s.Commissioner_Completed, 0) AS Commissioner_Completed,    a.Commissioner_Pending,    ISNULL(s.COMM_REJECTED, 0) AS COMM_REJECTED,    a.Payment_Count,    a.Payment_Amount,    a.PaymentPendingEaasthi AS [BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    a.BtoAConvertedCount,    a.SPACount INTO #FINAL_DATA FROM #AGGREGATED a LEFT JOIN #STATUS_AGG s ON a.GBAId = s.GBAId AND a.MD_ZoneId  = s.MD_ZoneId AND a.MD_WardId  = s.MD_WardId AND a.SourceType = s.SourceType; /* ============================================================ FINAL RESULT - one GROUPING SETS pass produces: - per ward, per SourceType   (ReportType = NEWKHATA / OTHER) - per ward, both sources     (ReportType = TOTAL) - grand total per SourceType (GBA = 'Total') - overall grand total        (GBA = 'Total', ReportType = TOTAL) This replaces #FINAL_OUTPUT + the 2 INSERTs + the 4-way UNION ALL. NOTE: the GROUPING SETS query is wrapped in a CTE (FinalResult) purely so the ORDER BY below can reference "ReportType" and "GBA" as real output columns. SQL Server does not allow a SELECT-list alias to be used inside a CASE expression in ORDER BY (only bare "ORDER BY alias" is allowed) - doing so for ReportType is what caused: Msg 207: Invalid column name 'ReportType'. No aggregation logic changed from the previous version. ============================================================ */ DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RESULT;  ;WITH FinalResult AS (     SELECT         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN 'Total' ELSE GBA END AS GBA,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE GBAId END AS GBAId,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE MD_ZoneId END AS MD_ZoneId,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN '' ELSE MD_Zonename END AS MD_Zonename,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE MD_WardId END AS MD_WardId,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN '' ELSE MD_WardName END AS MD_WardName,            SUM(Total_Citizens) AS Total_Citizens,            SUM(Sketch_Pending) AS Sketch_Pending,            SUM(CaseWorker_Pending) AS CaseWorker_Pending,            SUM(CaseWorker_Completed) AS CaseWorker_Completed,            SUM(JC_Pending) AS JC_Pending,            SUM(JC_Completed) AS JC_Completed,            SUM(JC_REJECTED) AS JC_REJECTED,            SUM(Commissioner_Completed) AS Commissioner_Completed,            SUM(Commissioner_Pending) AS Commissioner_Pending,            SUM(COMM_REJECTED) AS COMM_REJECTED,            SUM(Payment_Count) AS Payment_Count,            SUM(Payment_Amount) AS Payment_Amount,            SUM([BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)]) AS [BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],            SUM(BtoAConvertedCount) AS BtoAConvertedCount,            SUM(SPACount) AS SPACount,            CASE               WHEN                  GROUPING(SourceType) = 1               THEN 'TOTAL'               ELSE SourceType            END AS ReportType         FROM #FINAL_DATA         GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( ( GBA, GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_Zonename, MD_WardId, MD_WardName, SourceType ), ( GBA, GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_Zonename, MD_WardId, MD_WardName ), (SourceType), () ) ) SELECT * INTO #RESULT FROM FinalResult;   UPDATE  dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History SET    Total_Citizens            = 0,    Sketch_Pending            = 0,    CaseWorker_Pending        = 0,    CaseWorker_Completed      = 0,    JC_Pending                = 0,    JC_Completed              = 0,    JC_REJECTED               = 0,    Commissioner_Completed    = 0,    Commissioner_Pending      = 0,    COMM_REJECTED             = 0,    Payment_Count             = 0,    Payment_Amount            = 0,    ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata = 0,    BtoAConvertedCount        = 0,    SPACount                  = 0;   UPDATE  H  SET 	H.GBA = R.GBA,    H.Total_Citizens                   = R.Total_Citizens,    H.Sketch_Pending                   = R.Sketch_Pending,    H.CaseWorker_Pending               = R.CaseWorker_Pending,    H.CaseWorker_Completed             = R.CaseWorker_Completed,    H.JC_Pending                       = R.JC_Pending,    H.JC_Completed                     = R.JC_Completed,    H.JC_REJECTED                      = R.JC_REJECTED,    H.Commissioner_Completed           = R.Commissioner_Completed,    H.Commissioner_Pending             = R.Commissioner_Pending,    H.COMM_REJECTED                    = R.COMM_REJECTED,    H.Payment_Count                    = R.Payment_Count,    H.Payment_Amount                   = R.Payment_Amount,    H.BtoA_SPA_PendingEaasthiOver3Days = R.[BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    H.BtoAConvertedCount               = R.BtoAConvertedCount,    H.SPACount                         = R.SPACount,    H.B2ALoadAt                        = GETDATE() FROM dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History H INNER JOIN    #RESULT R ON    (       /* Normal Ward Records */       H.GBAId               = R.GBAId       AND H.MD_ZoneId       = R.MD_ZoneId       AND H.MD_WardId       = R.MD_WardId       AND H.applicationType = R.ReportType ) OR (       /* Grand Total OTHER / NEWKHATA / TOTAL */       H.MD_WardName         = 'Grand Total'       AND R.GBA             = 'Total'       AND H.applicationType = R.ReportType ); /* ============================================================ STEP 3 - INSERT RECORDS NOT PRESENT IN HISTORY Identity column is NOT included. ============================================================ */ INSERT INTO dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History    (       GBA,       GBAId,       MD_ZoneId,       MD_Zonename,       MD_WardId,       MD_WardName,       ReportType,       Total_Citizens,       Sketch_Pending,       CaseWorker_Pending,       CaseWorker_Completed,       JC_Pending,       JC_Completed,       JC_REJECTED,       Commissioner_Completed,       Commissioner_Pending,       COMM_REJECTED,       Payment_Count,       Payment_Amount,       BtoA_SPA_PendingEaasthiOver3Days,       BtoAConvertedCount,       SPACount,       applicationType, 	  B2ALoadAt    ) SELECT R.GBA,    R.GBAId,    R.MD_ZoneId,    R.MD_Zonename,    R.MD_WardId,    R.MD_WardName,    R.ReportType,    R.Total_Citizens,    R.Sketch_Pending,    R.CaseWorker_Pending,    R.CaseWorker_Completed,    R.JC_Pending,    R.JC_Completed,    R.JC_REJECTED,    R.Commissioner_Completed,    R.Commissioner_Pending,    R.COMM_REJECTED,    R.Payment_Count,    R.Payment_Amount,    R.[BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    R.BtoAConvertedCount,    R.SPACount,    R.ReportType AS applicationType,    getdate() FROM #RESULT R WHERE NOT EXISTS    (       SELECT 1       FROM dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History H       WHERE (             /* Normal records */             ISNULL(H.GBAId, -1)         = ISNULL(R.GBAId, -1)             AND ISNULL(H.MD_ZoneId, -1) = ISNULL(R.MD_ZoneId, -1)             AND ISNULL(H.MD_WardId, -1) = ISNULL(R.MD_WardId, -1)             AND H.applicationType       = R.ReportType )       OR (             /* Grand Total records */             H.MD_WardName         = 'Grand Total'             AND R.GBA             = 'Total'             AND H.applicationType = R.ReportType ) );  END

SQL_Text: CREATE PROCEDURE USP_I_GPSReport_WardWise (     @GBAId INT,     @MD_ZoneId INT,     @MD_Zonename VARCHAR(200),     @MD_WardId INT,     @MD_WardName VARCHAR(200),     @ReportType VARCHAR(20),      @ProcessedByRI INT = 0,     @AutoEscalated INT = 0,     @ReturnToRI INT = 0,     @RIPending INT = 0,     @QCRejected INT = 0,     @QCCompleted INT = 0,     @QCHold INT = 0,     @QCAssigned INT = 0,     @QCPending INT = 0,     @ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata INT = 0 ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      IF EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM GBA_Consolidated_Status_History         WHERE MD_WardId = @MD_WardId           AND ReportType = @ReportType     )     BEGIN          UPDATE GBA_Consolidated_Status_History         SET             GBAId = @GBAId,             MD_ZoneId = @MD_ZoneId,             MD_Zonename = @MD_Zonename,             MD_WardName = @MD_WardName,              ProcessedByRI = @ProcessedByRI,             AutoEscalated = @AutoEscalated,             ReturnToRI = @ReturnToRI,             RIPending = @RIPending,             QCRejected = @QCRejected,             QCCompleted = @QCCompleted,             QCHold = @QCHold,             QCAssigned = @QCAssigned,             QCPending = @QCPending,             ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata = @ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata,              GPSLoadedAt = GETDATE()          WHERE MD_WardId = @MD_WardId           AND ReportType = @ReportType;      END     ELSE     BEGIN          INSERT INTO GBA_Consolidated_Status_History         (             B2ALoadAt,             GBA,             GBAId,             MD_ZoneId,             MD_Zonename,             MD_WardId,             MD_WardName,             ReportType,             applicationType,              ProcessedByRI,             AutoEscalated,             ReturnToRI,             RIPending,             QCRejected,             QCCompleted,             QCHold,             QCAssigned,             QCPending,             ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata,              GPSLoadedAt         )         VALUES         (             GETDATE(),             'GBA',             @GBAId,             @MD_ZoneId,             @MD_Zonename,             @MD_WardId,             @MD_WardName,             @ReportType,             @ReportType,              @ProcessedByRI,             @AutoEscalated,             @ReturnToRI,             @RIPending,             @QCRejected,             @QCCompleted,             @QCHold,             @QCAssigned,             @QCPending,             @ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata,              GETDATE()         );      END END

SQL_Text: -- EXEC dbo.USP_S_GetOverallConsolidatedReport 3, 1; -- EXEC dbo.USP_S_GetOverallConsolidatedReport 2, 2; -- EXEC dbo.USP_S_GetOverallConsolidatedReport 3, 3;  CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_S_GetOverallConsolidatedReport] ( @Level INT, @FilterType INT ) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;  IF 1 = 0 BEGIN     SELECT         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS GBAId,         CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(200)) AS GBA,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS MD_ZoneId,         CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(200)) AS MD_Zonename,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS MD_WardId,         CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(200)) AS MD_WardName,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Total_Citizens,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Sketch_Pending,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS CaseWorker_Pending,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS CaseWorker_Completed,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS JC_Pending,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS JC_REJECTED,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS JC_Completed,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Commissioner_Pending,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS COMM_REJECTED,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Commissioner_Completed,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS Payment_Count,         CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Payment_Amount,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS BtoA_SPA_PendingEaasthiOver3Days,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS BtoAConvertedCount,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS SPACount,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS GPSTotalApplications,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS ProcessedByRI,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS AutoEscalated,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS ReturnToRI,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS RIPending,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS QCRejected,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS QCCompleted,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS QCHold,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS QCAssigned,         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS QCPending,          CAST(NULL AS INT) AS ApprovedNotPushedB2AKhata; END  DECLARE @ReportType VARCHAR(20); DECLARE @LatestB2ALoadAt DATETIME2(3);  /* ============================================================    LEVEL MAPPING     1 = OTHER    2 = NEWKHATA    3 = TOTAL    ============================================================ */  SET @ReportType =     CASE @Level         WHEN 1 THEN 'OTHER'         WHEN 2 THEN 'NEWKHATA'         WHEN 3 THEN 'TOTAL'     END;  /* ============================================================    VALIDATION    ============================================================ */  IF @ReportType IS NULL BEGIN     RAISERROR     (         'Invalid @Level. Use 1=OTHER, 2=NEWKHATA, 3=TOTAL.',         16,         1     );     RETURN; END;  IF @FilterType NOT IN (1, 2, 3) BEGIN     RAISERROR     (         'Invalid @FilterType. Use 1=GBA, 2=ZONE, 3=WARD.',         16,         1     );     RETURN; END;  /* ============================================================    GET THE CORRECT LATEST BATCH     Logic:    1. Find all batches for the selected ReportType.    2. Prefer the batch having the maximum number of rows.    3. SQL_Text: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_Ward_Consolidated_status_Report_Update] AS BEGIN    SET NOCOUNT ON;    /* ============================================================    CLEANUP TEMP TABLES    ============================================================ */    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BASE;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PAYMENT_DATA;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE125;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE130_CURR;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE130_HIST;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #STATUS_AGG;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AGGREGATED;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FINAL_DATA;    /* ============================================================    BASE DATA    ============================================================ */    SELECT DISTINCT a.App_Id,       a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationId,       a.GBA,       a.GBAId,       b.MD_ZoneId,       LTRIM(RTRIM( REPLACE( REPLACE(ISNULL(b.MD_Zonename, ''), CHAR(160), ' '), CHAR(9), ' ' ) )) AS MD_Zonename,       b.MD_WardId,       LTRIM(RTRIM( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( ISNULL(b.MD_WardName, ''), CHAR(160), ' ' -- Non-breaking space -> normal space       ), CHAR(9), ' '                                                                                     -- Tab -> space       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 1       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 2       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 3       ) )) AS MD_WardName,       a.App_Status,       a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       a.App_Source,       a.App_MotherEPID,       a.isFinalPaymentDone,       a.finalPaymentDate,       CASE          WHEN             a.App_Source = 'newkhata'          THEN 'NEWKHATA'          ELSE 'OTHER'       END AS SourceType    INTO #BASE    FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a WITH (NOLOCK)    INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.App_Id = b.MD_APP_ID    WHERE a.App_Active                   = 1    AND ISNULL(a.isProcessingFeePaid, 0) = 1    AND a.App_Status                     >= 10    AND ISNULL(a.IsPushedToGps, 0)       = 1;    /* Clustered index for the payment join (App_Id is unique per #BASE row) */ CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_AppId ON #BASE (App_Id); /* Covering non-clustered index for all the GROUP BY work below. This replaces the old #BASE_UNIQUE table+clustered-index copy. */ CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_Grouping ON #BASE    (       GBAId,       MD_ZoneId,       MD_WardId,       SourceType    ) INCLUDE    (       App_Id,       GBA,       MD_Zonename,       MD_WardName,       App_Status,       App_Source,       App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       isFinalPaymentDone,       finalPaymentDate    ) ; /* ============================================================ PAYMENT DATA ============================================================ */ SELECT f.FPC_AppId AS App_Id,    SUM(ISNULL(f.FPC_AmountCalculated, 0)) AS Payment_Amount INTO #PAYMENT_DATA FROM dbo.BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn f WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE f.FPC_Active      = 1 AND f.FPC_Pay_Isdisplay = 1 GROUP BY f.FPC_AppId; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_PAYMENT_DATA_AppId ON #PAYMENT_DATA (App_Id); /* ============================================================ MAIN AGGREGATION (counts, payments) - grain: GBA/Zone/Ward/SourceType ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    COUNT(*) AS Total_Citizens,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sketch_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CaseWorker_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1000, 1110) AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CaseWorker_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (14, 1000, 1110) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (150, 1500, 1100, 1111, 200, 300) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 0 AND a.App_Status = 300 AND a.finalPaymentDate <= DATEADD(DAY, -3, GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PaymentPendingEaasthi,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BtoAConvertedCount,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SPACount,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1500, 1100) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commissioner_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Status = 300 AND p.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_Count,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Status = 300 THEN ISNULL(p.Payment_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_Amount INTO #AGGREGATED FROM #BASE a LEFT JOIN #PAYMENT_DATA p ON a.App_Id = p.App_Id GROUP BY a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_AGGREGATED_Grouping ON #AGGREGATED (GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_WardId, SourceType); /* ============================================================ ROLE-BASED FLAGS - built ONCE from the transaction tables, instead of a correlated EXISTS re-run per metric. ============================================================ */ SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE125 FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE125 ON #ROLE125 (App_Id); SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE130_CURR FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE130_CURR ON #ROLE130_CURR (App_Id); SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE130_HIST FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran_hist WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130 AND Sts_MainAppStatus IN (200,                           300); CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE130_HIST ON #ROLE130_HIST (App_Id); /* ============================================================ STATUS-DERIVED METRICS - single pass replaces #JC_REJECTED + #COMM_COMPLETED + #COMM_REJECTED ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status = 110 AND r125.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_REJECTED,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (200, 300) AND ( r130h.App_Id IS NOT NULL OR r130c.App_Id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commissioner_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status = 1111 AND r130c.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMM_REJECTED INTO #STATUS_AGG FROM #BASE a LEFT JOIN #ROLE125 r125 ON a.App_Id = r125.App_Id LEFT JOIN #ROLE130_CURR r130c ON a.App_Id = r130c.App_Id LEFT JOIN #ROLE130_HIST r130h ON a.App_Id = r130h.App_Id WHERE a.App_Status IN (110,                        200,                        300,                        1111) GROUP BY a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_STATUS_AGG_Grouping ON #STATUS_AGG (GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_WardId, SourceType); /* ============================================================ FINAL DATA  ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    a.Total_Citizens,    a.Sketch_Pending,    a.CaseWorker_Pending,    a.CaseWorker_Completed,    a.JC_Pending,    a.JC_Completed,    ISNULL(s.JC_REJECTED, 0) AS JC_REJECTED,    ISNULL(s.Commissioner_Completed, 0) AS Commissioner_Completed,    a.Commissioner_Pending,    ISNULL(s.COMM_REJECTED, 0) AS COMM_REJECTED,    a.Payment_Count,    a.Payment_Amount,    a.PaymentPendingEaasthi AS [BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    a.BtoAConvertedCount,    a.SPACount INTO #FINAL_DATA FROM #AGGREGATED a LEFT JOIN #STATUS_AGG s ON a.GBAId = s.GBAId AND a.MD_ZoneId  = s.MD_ZoneId AND a.MD_WardId  = s.MD_WardId AND a.SourceType = s.SourceType; /* ============================================================ FINAL RESULT - one GROUPING SETS pass produces: - per ward, per SourceType   (ReportType = NEWKHATA / OTHER) - per ward, both sources     (ReportType = TOTAL) - grand total per SourceType (GBA = 'Total') - overall grand total        (GBA = 'Total', ReportType = TOTAL) This replaces #FINAL_OUTPUT + the 2 INSERTs + the 4-way UNION ALL. NOTE: the GROUPING SETS query is wrapped in a CTE (FinalResult) purely so the ORDER BY below can reference "ReportType" and "GBA" as real output columns. SQL Server does not allow a SELECT-list alias to be used inside a CASE expression in ORDER BY (only bare "ORDER BY alias" is allowed) - doing so for ReportType is what caused: Msg 207: Invalid column name 'ReportType'. No aggregation logic changed from the previous version. ============================================================ */ DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #RESULT;  ;WITH FinalResult AS (     SELECT         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN 'Total' ELSE GBA END AS GBA,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE GBAId END AS GBAId,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE MD_ZoneId END AS MD_ZoneId,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN '' ELSE MD_Zonename END AS MD_Zonename,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE MD_WardId END AS MD_WardId,         CASE WHEN GROUPING(GBA) = 1 THEN '' ELSE MD_WardName END AS MD_WardName,            SUM(Total_Citizens) AS Total_Citizens,            SUM(Sketch_Pending) AS Sketch_Pending,            SUM(CaseWorker_Pending) AS CaseWorker_Pending,            SUM(CaseWorker_Completed) AS CaseWorker_Completed,            SUM(JC_Pending) AS JC_Pending,            SUM(JC_Completed) AS JC_Completed,            SUM(JC_REJECTED) AS JC_REJECTED,            SUM(Commissioner_Completed) AS Commissioner_Completed,            SUM(Commissioner_Pending) AS Commissioner_Pending,            SUM(COMM_REJECTED) AS COMM_REJECTED,            SUM(Payment_Count) AS Payment_Count,            SUM(Payment_Amount) AS Payment_Amount,            SUM([BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)]) AS [BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],            SUM(BtoAConvertedCount) AS BtoAConvertedCount,            SUM(SPACount) AS SPACount,            CASE               WHEN                  GROUPING(SourceType) = 1               THEN 'TOTAL'               ELSE SourceType            END AS ReportType         FROM #FINAL_DATA         GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( ( GBA, GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_Zonename, MD_WardId, MD_WardName, SourceType ), ( GBA, GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_Zonename, MD_WardId, MD_WardName ), (SourceType), () ) ) SELECT * INTO #RESULT FROM FinalResult;   UPDATE  H  SET 	H.GBA = R.GBA,    H.Total_Citizens                   = R.Total_Citizens,    H.Sketch_Pending                   = R.Sketch_Pending,    H.CaseWorker_Pending               = R.CaseWorker_Pending,    H.CaseWorker_Completed             = R.CaseWorker_Completed,    H.JC_Pending                       = R.JC_Pending,    H.JC_Completed                     = R.JC_Completed,    H.JC_REJECTED                      = R.JC_REJECTED,    H.Commissioner_Completed           = R.Commissioner_Completed,    H.Commissioner_Pending             = R.Commissioner_Pending,    H.COMM_REJECTED                    = R.COMM_REJECTED,    H.Payment_Count                    = R.Payment_Count,    H.Payment_Amount                   = R.Payment_Amount,    H.BtoA_SPA_PendingEaasthiOver3Days = R.[BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    H.BtoAConvertedCount               = R.BtoAConvertedCount,    H.SPACount                         = R.SPACount,    H.B2ALoadAt                        = GETDATE() FROM dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History H INNER JOIN    #RESULT R ON    (       /* Normal Ward Records */       H.GBAId               = R.GBAId       AND H.MD_ZoneId       = R.MD_ZoneId       AND H.MD_WardId       = R.MD_WardId       AND H.applicationType = R.ReportType ) OR (       /* Grand Total OTHER / NEWKHATA / TOTAL */       H.MD_WardName         = 'Grand Total'       AND R.GBA             = 'Total'       AND H.applicationType = R.ReportType ); /* ============================================================ STEP 3 - INSERT RECORDS NOT PRESENT IN HISTORY Identity column is NOT included. ============================================================ */ INSERT INTO dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History    (       GBA,       GBAId,       MD_ZoneId,       MD_Zonename,       MD_WardId,       MD_WardName,       ReportType,       Total_Citizens,       Sketch_Pending,       CaseWorker_Pending,       CaseWorker_Completed,       JC_Pending,       JC_Completed,       JC_REJECTED,       Commissioner_Completed,       Commissioner_Pending,       COMM_REJECTED,       Payment_Count,       Payment_Amount,       BtoA_SPA_PendingEaasthiOver3Days,       BtoAConvertedCount,       SPACount,       applicationType, 	  B2ALoadAt    ) SELECT R.GBA,    R.GBAId,    R.MD_ZoneId,    R.MD_Zonename,    R.MD_WardId,    R.MD_WardName,    R.ReportType,    R.Total_Citizens,    R.Sketch_Pending,    R.CaseWorker_Pending,    R.CaseWorker_Completed,    R.JC_Pending,    R.JC_Completed,    R.JC_REJECTED,    R.Commissioner_Completed,    R.Commissioner_Pending,    R.COMM_REJECTED,    R.Payment_Count,    R.Payment_Amount,    R.[BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    R.BtoAConvertedCount,    R.SPACount,    R.ReportType AS applicationType,    getdate() FROM #RESULT R WHERE NOT EXISTS    (       SELECT 1       FROM dbo.GBA_Consolidated_Status_History H       WHERE (             /* Normal records */             ISNULL(H.GBAId, -1)         = ISNULL(R.GBAId, -1)             AND ISNULL(H.MD_ZoneId, -1) = ISNULL(R.MD_ZoneId, -1)             AND ISNULL(H.MD_WardId, -1) = ISNULL(R.MD_WardId, -1)             AND H.applicationType       = R.ReportType )       OR (             /* Grand Total records */             H.MD_WardName         = 'Grand Total'             AND R.GBA             = 'Total'             AND H.applicationType = R.ReportType ) ); SQL_Text: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_JC_AutoApprove_SPA_Applications] AS BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      BEGIN TRY          BEGIN TRANSACTION;          /*=========================================================           STEP 0 : DROP TEMP TABLES         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;           /*=========================================================           STEP 1 : GET BASE ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS         =========================================================*/          SELECT             a.App_Id,             a.App_DisplayId,             a.App_Status,             a.GBA,             a.GBAId,             a.App_MotherEPID,             a.App_Source,              ofi.BtoA_RoadId,             ofi.BtoA_RoadName,              ksr.Road_ID,             ksr.Road_Name,             ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt,              /* EPID Metadata */             b.MD_Zonename,             b.MD_WardName,             b.MD_SiteArea,             b.MD_ZoneId,             b.MD_WardId,             b.MD_StreetId,              /* Officer Details */             o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,             o.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,             o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType          INTO #Apps          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b             ON b.MD_APP_ID = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT                 Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,                 Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,                 Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,                 ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status in (14,1000)             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND b.MD_SiteArea <= 1000             AND ISNULL(ofi.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'             AND ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL 			AND a.App_JCApprovedDate is not null             AND a.App_JCApprovedDate < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))             AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired, 0) = 0          /*=========================================================           ROAD-WIDENING AREA VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 4                 AND ISNULL(o.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )         )          /*=========================================================           PROPERTY USE TYPE VS MASTER PLAN VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Residential -> ONLY Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential'             )              OR              /* Commercial -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*=========================================================           INDEX TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Apps_AppId         ON #Apps(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000)          GROUP BY             s.Sts_MainAppId          HAVING             MAX(s.Udt) < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));           /*=========================================================           INDEX JC TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JCMovedDate_AppId         ON #JCMovedDate(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 3 : INSERT ONLY NEW ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS            ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          --INSERT INTO dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications         --(         --    ApplicationDisplayID,         --    MotherEPID,         --    Application_Status,         --    Corporation,         --    Zone,         --    Ward,         --    IsGovtProperty,         --    BtoA_RoadId,         --    BtoA_RoadName,         --    Road_ID,         --    Road_Name,         --    GuidanceValueSqMt,         --    PropertyUseType,         --    Application_JCMovedDate,         --    Application_type,         --    BtoA_RoadType,         --    IsMasterPlanMismatch,         --    SiteArea,         --    JC_Pending_Days,         --    CreatedDate,         --    OfficerName,         --    IsAutoApprovedManually         --)          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status  in (14,1000)                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY         (             SELECT TOP 1                 ofc.Ofcr_Name,                 ofc.Ofcr_Id              FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc              WHERE                 ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId = a.MD_ZoneId                 AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)              ORDER BY                 ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. MUST HAVE AT LEAST ONE ROAD         =========================================================*/          EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id         )           /*=========================================================           2. ALL ROADS MUST BE PUBLIC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND             (                 r.BtoA_RoadType IS NULL                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType)) = ''                 OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType))) <> 'public'             )         )           /*=========================================================           3. EVERY ROAD MUST MATCH KSRAC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND NOT EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_AROMapping aro                  INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC k                     ON k.GBAZONEID = aro.GBAZONEID                     AND k.BBMPWardId = aro.BBMPWardId                     AND k.Road_Active = 1                  WHERE                     aro.GBAZONEID = a.MD_ZoneId                     AND aro.BBMPWardId = a.MD_WardId                     AND aro.BBMPStreetId = a.MD_StreetId                     AND aro.easthiULBNAME_CorpId = a.GBAId                     AND k.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL                     AND k.Road_ID = r.BtoA_RoadId                     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(k.Road_Name))                         = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadName))             )         )           /*=========================================================           4. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. EXCLUDE GOOGLE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteDtls s              WHERE s.Site_App_Id = a.App_Id              AND ISNULL(s.GooglePropertyType, '') = 'govt'         )           /*=========================================================           PREVENT DUPLICATE INSERTS         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications j              WHERE j.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId               AND ISNULL(j.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')         );           /*=========================================================           STEP 4 : UPDATE STATUS TRANSACTION            FINAL UPDATE 2            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE s         SET             s.Sts_PrevStatusId = s.Sts_MainAppStatus,             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 150,             s.Sts_CurrStatusId = 150,             s.Udt = GETDATE(),             s.Sts_comments = 'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             s.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,             s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125,             s.Sts_PrevOfficerId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerId          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000) and a.App_Status in (14,1000)  and a.App_Source='newkhata';           /*=========================================================           STEP 5 : UPDATE MAIN APPLICATION            FINAL UPDATE 3            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE a         SET             a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved = 1,             a.App_JCApprovedDate = GETDATE(),             a.App_AdditionalInfo =  'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             a.App_Status = 150,             a.App_UDte = GETDATE(),             a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch = 0          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') =                 ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE a.App_Status in (14,1000) and a.App_Source='newkhata';           /*=========================================================           STEP 6 : UPDATE TARGET TABLE            FINAL UPDATE 1            Update only records available in           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/  		UPDATE b 		SET  		    b.IsAutoApprovedManually = 1 		FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 		INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a 		    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 		    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 		WHERE  		ISNULL(b.IsAutoApprovedManually, 0) = 0 		AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 		AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 		AND a.App_Status = 150 		AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1;          /*=========================================================           CLEANUP         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;           COMMIT TRANSACTION;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;          DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);         DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;         DECLARE @ErrorState INT;          SELECT             @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),             @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),             @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();          RAISERROR         (             @ErrorMessage,             @ErrorSeverity,             @ErrorState         );      END CATCH;  	SELECT     a.App_Id,     a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,     a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,     a.App_Status,     a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved,     a.App_JCApprovedDate,     a.App_UDte,     a.App_AdditionalInfo,     b.CreatedDate AS AutoApprovalCreatedDate,     b.IsAutoApprovedManually 	FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a 	INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 	    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 	    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 	WHERE a.App_Status = 150 	  AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 	  AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 	  AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 	ORDER BY a.App_JCApprovedDate DESC;  END

          /*=========================================================           STEP 5 : UPDATE MAIN APPLICATION            FINAL UPDATE 3            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE a         SET             a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved = 1,             a.App_JCApprovedDate = GETDATE(),             a.App_AdditionalInfo =  'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             a.App_Status = 150,             a.App_UDte = GETDATE(),             a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch = 0          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') =                 ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE a.App_Status   in (14,1000) and a.App_Source='newkhata';           /*=========================================================           STEP 6 : UPDATE TARGET TABLE            FINAL UPDATE 1            Update only records available in           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/  		UPDATE b 		SET  		    b.IsAutoApprovedManually = 1 		FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 		INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a 		    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 		    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 		WHERE  		ISNULL(b.IsAutoApprovedManually, 0) = 0 		AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 		AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 		AND a.App_Status = 150 		AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1;          /*=========================================================           CLEANUP         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;           COMMIT TRANSACTION;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;          DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);         DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;         DECLARE @ErrorState INT;          SELECT             @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),             @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),             @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();          RAISERROR         (             @ErrorMessage,             @ErrorSeverity,             @ErrorState         );      END CATCH;  	SELECT     a.App_Id,     a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,     a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,     a.App_Status,     a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved,     a.App_JCApprovedDate,     a.App_UDte,     a.App_AdditionalInfo,     b.CreatedDate AS AutoApprovalCreatedDate,     b.IsAutoApprovedManually 	FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a 	INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 	    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 	    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 	WHERE a.App_Status = 150 	  AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 	  AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 	  AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 	ORDER BY a.App_JCApprovedDate DESC;  END

SQL_Text: --exec USP_U_Status_Master_Tran 13203,13,11,0,'','Rejected Message display',1 ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_U_Status_Master_Tran]     @MainApp_id BIGINT,     @Cby INT,     @Sts_MainAppStatus INT, 	@rejectedId INT, 	@rejectedText NVARCHAR(300), 	@comments NVARCHAR(MAX),     @Level INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      DECLARE @Sts_PrevStatusId INT,             @Sts_PrevOfficerId INT,             @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId INT,             @Sts_PrevOfficerName VARCHAR(MAX),             @Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo BIGINT,                          @Sts_CurrStatusId INT,             @Sts_CurrOfficerId INT,             @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId INT,             @Sts_CurrOfficerName VARCHAR(MAX),             @Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo BIGINT,             @message NVARCHAR(MAX),             @ResultStatus INT;      SET @Sts_CurrStatusId = @Sts_MainAppStatus;      BEGIN TRY          -------------------------------------------------------------------         -- LEVEL 1 : EXISTING LOGIC         -------------------------------------------------------------------         IF @Level = 1         BEGIN             IF EXISTS (SELECT 1                         FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran                         WHERE Sts_MainAppId = @MainApp_id)             BEGIN                 PRINT 'Level 1 - Entered Exists Loop';                  -- Get current officer from mst_Officer (EXISTING BEHAVIOUR)                 SELECT                      @Sts_CurrOfficerId       = Ofcr_Id,                     @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId   = Ofcr_RoleId,                     @Sts_CurrOfficerName     = Ofcr_Name,                     @Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo = Ofcr_MNo                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_Officer                  WHERE Ofcr_Id = @Cby;                  PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerId;                 PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId;                 PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerName;                 PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo;                  -- Fetch previous status values                 SELECT                      @Sts_PrevStatusId        = Sts_CurrStatusId,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerId       = Sts_CurrOfficerId,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerName     = Sts_CurrOfficerName,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo = Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId   = Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId                 FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran                 WHERE Sts_MainAppId = @MainApp_id;                  PRINT @Sts_PrevStatusId;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerId;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerName;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId;                  -- Update Status Master Tran                 UPDATE SM                 SET                      SM.Sts_MainAppStatus       = @Sts_MainAppStatus,                     SM.Sts_CurrStatusId        = @Sts_CurrStatusId,                     SM.Sts_PrevStatusId        = @Sts_PrevStatusId,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerId       = @Sts_PrevOfficerId,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerName     = @Sts_PrevOfficerName,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo = @Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId   = @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId,                     SM.Sts_CurrOfficerId       = @Sts_CurrOfficerId,                     SM.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId   = @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,                     SM.Udt                     = GETDATE(), 					SM.Sts_rejectedID			= @rejectedId, 					SM.Sts_rejectedText			=@rejectedText, 					SM.Sts_comments				=@comments                 FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran SM                 WHERE SM.Sts_MainAppId = @MainApp_id; 				 				 				IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0                 BEGIN 				print 'Current status details' 				print @Sts_MainAppStatus 				print @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId                  				if(@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId=125) 				begin 					if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=150) 					begin 					 SET @message = 'Application Approved'; 						SET @ResultStatus = 1;  						UPDATE BtoAMainApp  						SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,  							App_UBy    = @Cby, 							App_UDte   = GETDATE() 						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  						  AND App_Active = 1; 					 						UPDATE a set a.CompletedDate=getdate(), a.Status='Completed',a.UDate=GETDATE(), a.UBy=@Cby, a.URole=@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp a inner join BtoAMainApp b on a.AppId=b.App_Id   						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  AND App_Active = 1; 					 					End 					else if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=1500 or @Sts_MainAppStatus=1100 ) 					begin 					 SET @message = 'Application Successfully Recommended to Commissioner'; 						SET @ResultStatus = 1;  						UPDATE BtoAMainApp  						SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,  							App_UBy    = @Cby, 							App_UDte   = GETDATE() 						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  						  AND App_Active = 1;  						UPDATE a set a.CompletedDate=getdate(), a.Status='Completed',a.UDate=GETDATE(), a.UBy=@Cby,a.URole=@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp a inner join BtoAMainApp b on a.AppId=b.App_Id   						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  AND App_Active = 1; 					End 					else if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=110) -- modified as 27 APril 2026 					begin 			  					 						  SET @ResultStatus = 1; 						  SET @message = 'Application Rejected Successfully';  						UPDATE BtoAMainApp  						SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,  							App_UBy    = @Cby, 							App_UDte   = GETDATE() 						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  						  AND App_Active = 1;  						UPDATE a set a.CompletedDate=getdate(), a.Status='Completed',a.UDate=GETDATE(), a.UBy=@Cby,a.URole=@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp a inner join BtoAMainApp b on a.AppId=b.App_Id   						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  AND App_Active = 1; 						 					End 					 				end 				else if(@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId=116) 				begin 					  					if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=1000  ) 					begin 					 SET @message = 'Application successfully recommended for Approval to the Joint Commissioner.'; 						SET @ResultStatus = 1;  						UPDATE BtoAMainApp  						SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,  							App_UBy    = @Cby, 							App_UDte   = GETDATE(), 							 App_JCMovedDate =getdate()   						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  						  AND App_Active = 1; 					End 					else  if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=1110 ) 					begin 					 SET @message = 'Application successfully recommended for rejection to the Joint Commissioner'; 						SET @ResultStatus = 1;  						UPDATE BtoAMainApp  						SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,  							App_UBy    = @Cby, 							App_UDte   = GETDATE(), 							 App_JCMovedDate =getdate()   						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  						  AND App_Active = 1; 					End 					  				end 				else 				begin                     SET @message = 'Status updated successfully';                     SET @ResultStatus = 1;                      UPDATE BtoAMainApp                      SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,                          App_UBy    = @Cby,                         App_UDte   = GETDATE()                     WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id                        AND App_Active = 1; 				End                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     SET @message = 'No matching record found for update';                     SET @ResultStatus = 0;                 END             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 SET @message = 'Application ID not found';                 SET @ResultStatus = 0;             END         END          -------------------------------------------------------------------         -- LEVEL 2 : FULL SEPARATE FLOW (HARDCODED OFFICER)         -------------------------------------------------------------------         ELSE IF @Level = 2         BEGIN             IF EXISTS (SELECT 1                         FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran                         WHERE Sts_MainAppId = @MainApp_id)             BEGIN                 PRINT 'Level 2 - Entered Exists Loop';                  -- HARD CODED CURRENT OFFICER VALUES HERE                 SET @Sts_CurrOfficerId       = @Cby;               -- <== change                 SET @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId   = 1;                 -- <== change                 SET @Sts_CurrOfficerName     = 'Citizen';  -- <== change                 SET @Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo = NULL;         -- <== change                  PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerId;                 PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId;                 PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerName;                 PRINT @Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo;                  -- Fetch previous status values                 SELECT                      @Sts_PrevStatusId        = Sts_CurrStatusId,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerId       = Sts_CurrOfficerId,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerName     = Sts_CurrOfficerName,                     --@Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo = Sts_CurrOfficerMobileNo,                     @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId   = Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId                 FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran                 WHERE Sts_MainAppId = @MainApp_id;                  PRINT @Sts_PrevStatusId;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerId;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerName;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo;                 PRINT @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId;                  -- Update Status Master Tran                 UPDATE SM                 SET                      SM.Sts_MainAppStatus       = @Sts_MainAppStatus,                     SM.Sts_CurrStatusId        = @Sts_CurrStatusId,                     SM.Sts_PrevStatusId        = @Sts_PrevStatusId,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerId       = @Sts_PrevOfficerId,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerName     = @Sts_PrevOfficerName,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo = @Sts_PrevOfficerMobileNo,                     SM.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId   = @Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId,                     SM.Sts_CurrOfficerId       = @Sts_CurrOfficerId,                     SM.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId   = @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,                     SM.Udt                     = GETDATE(), 					SM.Sts_rejectedID			= @rejectedId, 					SM.Sts_rejectedText			=@rejectedText, 					SM.Sts_comments				=@comments                 FROM BtoA_Status_Master_Tran SM                 WHERE SM.Sts_MainAppId = @MainApp_id;                  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0                 BEGIN                     SET @message = 'Status updated successfully';                     SET @ResultStatus = 1;                      UPDATE BtoAMainApp                      SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,                          App_UBy    = @Cby,                         App_UDte   = GETDATE()                     WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id                        AND App_Active = 1;                 END                 ELSE                 BEGIN                     SET @message = 'No matching record found for update';                     SET @ResultStatus = 0;                 END             END             ELSE             BEGIN                 SET @message = 'Application ID not found';                 SET @ResultStatus = 0;             END         END          -------------------------------------------------------------------         -- INVALID LEVEL         -------------------------------------------------------------------         ELSE         BEGIN             SET @message = 'Invalid Level';             SET @ResultStatus = 0;         END     END TRY     BEGIN CATCH         SET @ResultStatus = 0;         SET @message = ERROR_MESSAGE();     END CATCH;      SELECT @message AS Message, @ResultStatus AS Status; END;
